scenarios.request: Take over this unfamiliar repository, recover the active architecture, fix the highest-value issue, validate it, and carry the change through CI and delivery.
scenarios.rationale: Whole-repository takeover and delivery require one end-to-end engineering owner.

scenarios.request: Add organization-scoped API keys with persistence, authorization checks, tests, migration safety, and release verification.
scenarios.rationale: Backend, data, auth, migration, and release are material.

scenarios.request: Build the billing settings feature end to end: API, database changes, permissions, React UI, tests, and deployment verification.
scenarios.rationale: Cross-layer outcome stays with full-stack owner while UI work may be delegated.

scenarios.request: Redesign the Electron workspace and also update IPC/state wiring so the new interaction model works in the real desktop runtime.
scenarios.rationale: Visual work is material, but host/runtime behavior keeps full-stack ownership primary.

scenarios.request: Redesign this existing analytics dashboard using the current design system, implement the responsive UI, and perform rendered visual QA.
scenarios.rationale: The requested outcome is primarily UI/frontend design and rendered implementation.

scenarios.request: Implement this accepted Figma screen in the existing frontend with responsive behavior and pixel-faithful visual QA.
scenarios.rationale: Design-to-code is a bounded frontend specialist task when no broader system change is requested.

scenarios.request: Explore three visual directions for this landing page and critique the hierarchy; do not modify the repository yet.
scenarios.rationale: Pure visual exploration belongs to the design specialist.

scenarios.request: Migrate the account schema without downtime, preserve backward compatibility, update readers and writers, and verify rollout and rollback.
scenarios.rationale: Migration and compatibility are full-stack/runtime ownership.

scenarios.request: Investigate this production regression, contain impact, identify the causal change, patch it, and verify recovery.
scenarios.rationale: Incident response and recovery require the primary engineering owner.

scenarios.request: Find why p99 latency doubled, establish a comparable baseline, fix the bottleneck, and prove the improvement under the same workload.
scenarios.rationale: Performance work is not a frontend-design routing problem.

scenarios.request: Prepare and execute the release, validate the exact artifact, monitor health, and handle rollback if the rollout degrades.
scenarios.rationale: Release and operations remain with the full-stack owner.

scenarios.request: What does Array.prototype.map do in JavaScript?
scenarios.rationale: General software explanation should not force either Studio Skill.
